study type: nested case-control within a cohort study
cohort: The study participants were singleton pregnancies complicated by placental abruption with a live born infant, from two academic reference centers in France.
finding: Out-of-hospital placental abruption combined with bradycardia at admission was associated with a major risk of moderate or severe HIE or death, and an optimal decision-to-delivery interval did not guarantee the absence of an adverse neonatal outcome.
